rights_boundary: The manifest records public full-text routes and the rights evidence found for each selected version. A paper license does not grant rights to its cited sources, source corpora, datasets, repository code, or third-party figures. Sharma’s CC BY 4.0 evidence is scoped to arXiv v4; the ICLR proceedings license was not verified. No paper text, PDFs, dataset records, annotations, or holdout assignments belong in this manifest.
selection_method: Preserve the final ten candidates from the owner’s research checkpoints on issue #29. Select an exact paper version with a public full-text route, record bibliographic and rights evidence per item, and retain the stated exclusions and scope limits. Do not treat access as blanket reuse permission.
